propositions: The documentation specialist currently declares single-turn execution and lacks repository access, preventing grounded detection of changed public contracts requiring documentation updates.
The rubric enforces a diff-only contradiction rule requiring all evidence to appear inside the diff, which prevents accurate omission and role-violation findings.
The agentic upgrade requires execution mode change to `agentic` and routing change to `exec: AGENT`, plus revised rubric with read-only repository navigation and two-source evidence citations.

Every finding must cite a changed `path:line` plus a second repository source proving inaccuracy, policy violation, or bounded omission; repository-wide searches with no owned location produce no finding.
Documentation role checks must cite `docs/documentation-policy.md` or `docs/generated-artifacts.md`; findings require abstention when audience, ownership, or role is ambiguous.

Code-review eval cases supplying `files` must execute against a disposable fixture repository; the documentation eval spec must include repository-backed cases, deterministic scorers, gold sets, and no-fire cases for ambiguous ownership and unowned locations.
